heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy with the chance of s shower, except slight chance southeast, under increasing clouds. Temperatures from the mid 60s to lower 70s from Route 4 southward, upper 50s to mid 60s between Route 4 and Route 2, and low to mid 50s from Route 2 northward. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy with patches of drizzle and the slight chance of a shower, mainly in the northern mountains. Lows in the 40s. Winds becoming northwest 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Decreasing clouds; becoming mostly sunny in southern valleys. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s north, and mid 50s to around 60 in the south. North to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.
